text: The Minimalist Entrepreneur - by Sahil Lavingia | Derek Sivers Derek Sivers Books I’ve read : The Minimalist Entrepreneur - by Sahil Lavingia how strongly I recommend it: 8 /10 ISBN: 0593192397 date read: 2022-04-30 A must-read for any potential founder of a small online business. Brilliant insights into starting something simply and sensibly. Best guide to the new world of starting from anywhere. (( Sorry I don't have any real notes on this book.
